title: ALVIDA MOULA HUSSAIN ALVIDA MOULA
body:
ALVIDA MOULA HUSSAIN ALVIDA MOULA
<<DIVIDER>>
1. KARENGE AHLE AZA AGLE SAAL PHIR MATAM
BICHEGA FARSH E AZA PHIR SE HOGA TERA GHAM
<<MINI>>
ALVIDA MOULA HUSSAIN ALVIDA MOULA
<<DIVIDER>>
2. BALA KE DASHT ME QURBAAN KARKE GHAR SAARA WATAN KO JAATE HAIN DEEN KO BACHAKE AHLE HARAM ALVIDA MOULA HUSSAIN ALVIDA MOULA
3. AZA KE MAAH KA AB IQTETAAM HOTA HAI SADAYEN AATI HAIN JO ALVIDAH KI PAIHAM ALVIDA MOULA HUSSAIN ALVIDA MOULA
4. NAZAR AB AYENGE VEERAN SAB AZA KHANE
YE SONCH SONCH JE HAR AANKH HOTI HAI PURNAM ALVIDA MOULA HUSSAIN ALVIDA MOULA
5. AYE IBNE FATIMA KAISE KARE TUJHE RUQSAT
TADAP RAHEIN HAI JIGAR ROO RAHE HAI DIL PURGHAM
<<MINI>>
ALVIDA MOULA HUSSAIN ALVIDA MOULA
<<DIVIDER>>
6. HAMARE GHAR KI THI ROUNAQ ALAM SE JHOOLE SE
HAMARE GHAR ME THI MEHMAAN FATIMA HAR DUM
<<MINI>>
ALVIDA MOULA HUSSAIN ALVIDA MOULA
<<DIVIDER>>
7. RAHEGI HASHR TALAK SHAH KI AZADARI
IMAM E WAQT KA MOHSIN KAMAAL HAI YEH KARAM
<<MINI>>
ALVIDA MOULA HUSSAIN ALVIDA MOULA
<<DIVIDER>>
8. HAI ILTEJA KE DIKHADIJIYE HAME RAOZA
YEH AARZOI KAREN AAKE HAM WAHAN MATAM
<<MINI>>
ALVIDA MOULA HUSSAIN ALVIDA MOULA
<<DIVIDER>>
AZZ..MOHSIN KAMAAL RAZVI
